title: Apply uploaded Hans Laser logo as app branding (header + favicon)

requirements.text: Generate production-ready PNG logo assets from the uploaded file (hans logo.jpeg) and add them as static assets under frontend/public/assets/generated.

quotes: use this logo for the app

acceptanceCriteria: New logo image files exist in frontend/public/assets/generated using the filenames specified in imageRequirements.required.
Generated images are cropped/fit to a clean square mark suitable for an app icon (no unintended clipping).
Images have consistent colors with the uploaded logo and look sharp at small sizes.

requirements.text: Update the app header branding to use the newly generated logo asset instead of the current hardcoded logo path.

quotes: use this logo for the app

acceptanceCriteria: frontend/src/components/AppHeader.tsx uses the new generated logo filename (not /assets/generated/hans-laser-logo.dim_512x512.png).
The logo renders correctly in the header in both light and dark mode backgrounds (no broken image).

requirements.text: Add favicon and app icon links in frontend/index.html using the newly generated logo assets.

quotes: use this logo for the app

acceptanceCriteria: frontend/index.html includes a favicon link pointing to the generated 32x32 (or 48x48) PNG.
frontend/index.html includes an apple-touch-icon link pointing to the generated 180x180 PNG.
After build, the browser tab favicon displays the new logo (no missing favicon requests in devtools network panel).

constraints: Do not modify any files under frontend/src/components/ui (Shadcn components are read-only).
Do not modify any files in frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.ts, frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.tsx, frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts, or frontend/src/main.tsx (immutable paths).
Do not route logo delivery through the backend; serve it as a static frontend asset.
nonGoals: Changing authentication, role-based routing, or user/profile flows.
Rebranding any text content beyond swapping the visual logo assets.
Adding a PWA manifest or installability features unless explicitly requested.

required: Square logo app icon derived from the uploaded logo (hans-laser-app-icon.dim_512x512.png)
Small favicon version derived from the uploaded logo (hans-laser-favicon.dim_32x32.png)
Apple touch icon derived from the uploaded logo (hans-laser-apple-touch-icon.dim_180x180.png)
